prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic bright domestic bedroom portrait with a relaxed social-media fashion feel, preserving the supplied pastel-pink lace styling and black striped socks.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long honey-brown half-up hair, loose face-framing strands, fair natural skin texture and a soft engaging gaze. She wears a pastel-pink lace bra and matching pink bottoms, black thigh-high socks with two white horizontal stripes, small gold hoops and a delicate gold chain with a dark charm.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium portrait from the thighs upward, seated on light bedding and facing camera with a slight forward lean. Keep both hands resting comfortably on the upper thighs, head tilted subtly right and legs slightly apart. Include a white wall, framed black-and-gold abstract artwork on the left and a dark pillow or fabric at the right edge.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffuse daylight from front-left, soft even highlights on the face, shoulders and lace, and subtle shadows beneath the chin and along the right side. Maintain a relaxed, confident, clean domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical portrait framing, 50–85mm equivalent lens, eye-level camera with slight seated high-angle relationship, shallow depth of field, sharp subject detail, softly softened artwork and wall, realistic pores and fabric texture.
